description: A wide rounded-corner platform rests on a scissor linkage whose crossing diagonal bars fold into a central diamond. The lower bar ends meet a long horizontal base line as wide as the platform.
A horizontal rectangular rail at the top holds a short vertical stem ending in an open two-pronged claw. The curved prongs reach down toward a separate horizontal rectangular block at the bottom.

A squared C-shaped frame with a doubled outline opens to the left. A short T-shaped screw handle stands above its top arm and another hangs below its bottom arm, and a single horizontal line reaches into the open mouth.

Two quarter-round jaws face each other across a narrow gap above a U-shaped channel on short legs, standing on a horizontal base line. A tall lever with a round knob rises on the right, crossed by a short horizontal crank arm.

A flat square-cornered rectangular platform tops two mirrored zigzag legs that cross twice, enclosing a diamond between an upper and lower X. Their feet meet a horizontal base line the same width as the platform.
A tape roll seen face-on: a large outer circle around a concentric inner core circle. A flat strip unrolls from the bottom of the roll toward the left and ends in a V-notched cut.
A tape roll seen face-on: a thick outer ring around a round inner core. A short squared tab of tape peels away from the lower-right edge of the roll.

A dustpan seen from the side: a wedge-shaped pan slopes down to a flat front lip at the lower left, backed by a rectangular rear wall on the right. A tall upright handle with a rounded, pointed top rises from the rear wall.

A long closed oval runs on a diagonal from lower left to upper right, with a second looping strand curling over its upper-left and lower-right ends and two short dashes inside. The overlapping strands make the subject hard to read.
A toothed gear outline surrounds a round handwheel. Six straight spokes radiate evenly from a small central hub circle to the wheel rim.
An upright rounded-rectangle device has a rectangular display window near the top with a slanted needle rising from a small pivot. A round button with a vertical mark sits centred below the display.

concept: Head with Safety Goggles and Mask
description: A round head seen head-on wears wide goggles across the brow, the two joined lenses dipping at a central bridge, and a rounded respirator mask covering the lower face. Small ears show at either side.

A flashlight stands upright: a wide rectangular lens rim on top above a trapezoidal head that tapers into a narrower rectangular body. A small switch mark sits on the body's right edge and a short rounded cap closes the bottom.
A mop seen head-on: a thin vertical handle enters a small collar atop a bell-shaped head. A horizontal band crosses the upper head and three curved strands run down its flared lower skirt.
Two long capsule-shaped handles lie side by side on a diagonal from lower left to upper right. A circular pivot overlaps both at the centre, with a straight seam line running through it.
A rounded capsule handle lies horizontally along the bottom with a solid pivot dot at its right end. A pointed blade swings up diagonally from that pivot toward the upper left.

A hand entering from the right grips an upright tool whose top bends left into a short horizontal head, with a small cap visible above the knuckles. Stacked finger, thumb and wrist lines are dense and the held object is hard to identify.
A flashlight lies on a diagonal: a rounded handle with a small switch mark at the lower left widens into a flared head. Three short rays spread from its lens at the upper right.
Three identical drill bits stand upright side by side. Each is a tall narrow rectangle with a pointed tip and diagonal spiral flute marks crossing its upper two-thirds.

An upright hammer head with a rounded pointed top is fixed to a horizontal double-line handle entering from the left. Directly beneath it a small T-shaped nail head sits between short impact dashes on either side.

A claw hammer tilts on a diagonal with its curved claw at the upper left, squared striking face at the right, and double-line handle running to the lower left. A separate small T-shaped nail stands upright in the lower-right corner.
A nail lies on a diagonal from lower left to upper right. Its long straight shank ends in a pointed tip at the lower left and is capped by a domed half-round head at the upper right.
A nail lies on a diagonal from lower left to upper right. Its long straight shank ends in a pointed tip at the lower left and is capped by a flat rectangular head set crosswise at the upper right.
A wide flat hexagon with horizontal top and bottom edges and pointed left and right corners. A round hole sits at its centre.
Two round washers overlap on a diagonal. The upper-left washer is a complete outer ring around a smaller inner ring, while the lower-right one sits behind it and shows only open arcs of its rings.

Two horizontal capsule jaws point left, one at the top and one lower down, with a short block at the right end of each. Three short thread marks sit between them, and a horizontal screw with a round knob crosses a small upright block at the lower right.
Pliers stand open, seen flat: two long straight handles splay apart toward the bottom and cross at a solid round pivot. Above the pivot two narrow curved jaws rise and meet at pointed tips.

A tape measure case with rounded upper corners and a flat base holds a round central hub. A long flat tape ribbon snakes out from its lower right, folding back once in an S-curve before running off to the right.
An L-shaped square with a tall vertical arm and a long horizontal arm meeting at the lower left. Evenly spaced short tick marks run along the outer left edge and the bottom edge.
A tall narrow rounded rectangle stands upright. Five evenly spaced short tick marks run down its left edge.
Pliers lie on a diagonal with pointed teardrop jaws at the upper left, parted by a narrow notch. Two thick rounded capsule handles splay apart toward the lower right from the crossing pivot.

A half-dome blade guard covers the upper half of a circular saw, with a round hub of concentric circles at its centre. The jagged toothed lower half of the blade is exposed below the guard's straight edge.
A cordless drill faces right: a horizontal body with a rounded back narrows to a small chuck and a thin straight bit. A slanted grip drops beneath the body onto a wide rounded battery pack.
A looped handle arches over the upper left of a half-round blade guard that sits on a horizontal base-plate line. A round toothed blade with a solid central hub projects below the plate.
A half-exposed toothed saw blade hangs down from a horizontal top rail with curled ends. Beneath it lies a separate horizontal rectangular plank with a wavy grain line along its middle.
A jigsaw faces left: a rounded boxy body with a capsule-shaped grip slot sits on a horizontal base plate pierced by a vertical blade. A short cord curls out from the lower right of the body.
An open jaw trap drawn as an L: a vertical arm and a horizontal arm meet at a round hinge with a central dot in the lower-left corner. The inner edge of each arm carries a row of zigzag teeth.
A closed safety pin lies on a diagonal: a round coiled spring at the lower left and two long parallel wires running to the upper right. A hooked clasp head curls over the upper-right end.

A round saw blade with jagged teeth rises through the centre of a flat rectangular table top, with a small half-round hub at the surface. The table stands on two straight legs joined by a horizontal crossbar.

A large round saw blade with irregular jagged teeth and a small central hub circle. A long horizontal cutting line crosses below its centre, with the lower part of the blade continuing beneath the line.

Scissors stand open with blades pointing up: two long pointed blades with outward-bowed backs cross at the middle. Two round finger loops sit at the bottom, one broken where the other handle crosses it.
Scissors form an X: two straight narrow blades cross from the lower finger loops to rounded tips at the upper corners. Two round finger loops sit at the bottom left and bottom right.
A knife points down at an angle, its curved blade tip touching a long horizontal surface line. Short strokes burst outward on either side of the point of contact.
A rounded square sticker has its lower-left corner folded back on a diagonal. The curled flap shows a rounded inner corner resting over the lower part of the sticker face.
A horizontal capsule-shaped knife body lies along the bottom. A single straight pointed awl stands upright from the centre of its top edge.
A horizontal capsule-shaped knife body lies along the bottom. A hooked can-opener blade leans up from its top edge, the curved hook near its tip facing left.
A horizontal capsule-shaped knife body lies along the bottom. A narrow saw blade angles up toward the upper left from its top edge, its left edge serrated with small teeth.

A wide capsule-shaped knife body lies along the bottom with two tools standing up from its top edge. A tall leaning blade rises on the left, and a pointed scissor blade with a small inner loop rises on the right.
A long straight handle runs on a diagonal from the upper right to a short crosswise brush head at the lower left. Scattered short dashes spray outward from the bristle end.
A plunger stands upright: a tall capsule grip on top joins a thin vertical shaft, which enters a small collar on a dome-shaped rubber cup. The cup rests on a short horizontal base line.
An open rectangular toolbox has a small rounded notch in the middle of its top edge. An upright open-end wrench on the left and a hammer leaning right both rise well above the rim.
A fist grips an axe handle on a diagonal, with the flared axe head at the upper right beyond the knuckles. Wavy forearm lines trail down beneath the hand, and the stacked finger lines are dense.
A hatchet lies on a diagonal: a straight handle rises from the lower left into a wedge-shaped head. A small butt block caps the head and a flaring curved cutting edge faces the lower right.
A combination wrench lies on a diagonal: a closed ring end with a round hole at the upper right, a straight shank, and an open crescent jaw at the lower left.
A wrench with a broad rounded head at the upper left, its open jaw notched toward the upper left. A thick straight handle with a rounded end runs down to the lower right.
A flat rectangular plate lies on a diagonal toward the lower right. A short hooked neck rises from its centre to a capsule handle at the upper left.
A triangular trowel blade points toward the lower right. A short bent neck joins it to a capsule handle angled toward the upper left.
A T-shaped tool: a long horizontal crossbar with rounded ends tops a straight vertical shaft. The shaft widens at the bottom into a rectangular socket with a square opening.

A glue gun lies on a diagonal with its pointed nozzle at the lower left, a trigger hanging below the barrel, and a glue stick poking out at the upper right. A wavy line of glue trails along the bottom.
A fist grips a hammer handle on a diagonal, with the rectangular head and curved claw at the upper right beyond the knuckles. Wavy forearm lines trail below, and the stacked finger lines are dense.
A claw hammer stands upright: a long rectangular handle with a narrow neck rises into the head. A small square striking face sits on the left and a long curved claw sweeps down on the right.

A round key ring at the top holds three keys through small rings: one extends horizontally to the right, one hangs straight down with a notched tip, and one angles to the lower left. The crossing strokes make it hard to read.
A triangular trowel blade sits at the lower left. A short twisted neck joins it to a tapered, flat-ended handle angled toward the upper right.
A pickaxe lies on a diagonal: a straight handle rises from the lower left to a crescent head arcing across the upper right. The head tapers to points at both ends, with a small cap above the joint.
Pliers lie on a diagonal with jaws open at the upper right, their inner edges curved. They cross at a waisted pivot and extend two long, slightly curved handles toward the lower left.
A hand saw lies on a diagonal: a long blade with a toothed lower edge tapers from the upper left. It is fixed to a rounded handle at the lower right with a D-shaped grip hole.
A slim tool lies on a diagonal: a rounded capsule handle with a small dot at the lower left, a thin straight shaft, and a pointed triangular tip at the upper right.
A screwdriver lies on a diagonal: a long capsule handle with a waisted collar at the upper left, a thin straight shaft, and a flat solid blade tip at the lower right.
A shovel lies on a diagonal: a pointed spade blade at the lower left, a long straight shaft, and a rounded grip block at the upper right.

A pipe wrench lies on a diagonal: a long straight handle rises from the lower left through a rectangular adjusting collar. A hooked upper jaw curls over the upper right, with a short stub projecting below the collar.
An offset crank rod bends in a zigzag from a square grip at the lower left, through a diagonal middle section, to a rounded socket block at the upper right. A small square bit caps the socket end.
A hand saw lies on a diagonal: a rounded handle with a D-shaped grip hole at the lower left and a blade extending to the upper right. The blade's lower edge is cut into broad wavy teeth.
A fist grips a wrench handle on a diagonal, with the open crescent jaw at the upper right beyond the knuckles. Wavy forearm lines trail below, and the stacked finger lines are dense.

An open-end wrench and a screwdriver cross in an X. The wrench runs from upper left to lower right with a crescent jaw at each end; the screwdriver runs from a capsule handle at the lower left to a flat tip at the upper right.
An open-end wrench lies on a diagonal: a straight handle with a rounded end at the lower left rises to a crescent jaw. The jaw opens toward the upper right.
Two double-ended open wrenches cross in an X. Each has a crescent jaw at both ends, and the four jaws open outward toward the corners.
